## account_allocations

What an investment account holds by asset class, effective-dated like a stake.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | no |  | PK |
| `account_id` | INTEGER | no |  | FK → `accounts.id` ON DELETE CASCADE |

| `percentage` | NUMERIC(5, 2) | no |  |  |
| `effective_from` | DATE | no |  |  |
| `effective_to` | DATE | yes |  |  |

- CHECK `ck_allocations_date_order`: `effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from`
- CHECK `ck_allocations_percentage_range`: `percentage > 0 AND percentage <= 100`

| `risk_tolerance` | risk_tolerance (conservative \| moderate \| aggressive) | no |  |  |

- CHECK `ck_planning_assumptions_expected_real_return_bps`: `expected_real_return_bps BETWEEN -1000 AND 2000`

- CHECK `ck_planning_assumptions_mix_totals_100`: `target_us_equity_pct + target_intl_equity_pct + target_bonds_pct + target_cash_pct + target_other_pct = 100`
- CHECK `ck_planning_assumptions_target_bonds_pct`: `target_bonds_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100`
- CHECK `ck_planning_assumptions_target_cash_pct`: `target_cash_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100`
- CHECK `ck_planning_assumptions_target_intl_equity_pct`: `target_intl_equity_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100`
- CHECK `ck_planning_assumptions_target_other_pct`: `target_other_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100`
- CHECK `ck_planning_assumptions_target_us_equity_pct`: `target_us_equity_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100`
- CHECK `ck_planning_assumptions_tax_deferred_withdrawal_tax_bps`: `tax_deferred_withdrawal_tax_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 6000`
- CHECK `ck_planning_assumptions_withdrawal_band`: `withdrawal_low_bps <= withdrawal_high_bps`
- CHECK `ck_planning_assumptions_withdrawal_high_bps`: `withdrawal_high_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 1500`
- CHECK `ck_planning_assumptions_withdrawal_low_bps`: `withdrawal_low_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 1500`
